evidence.claim: Hongfa produce relè, apparecchiature elettriche di bassa e media tensione, connettori, condensatori e componenti di precisione per oltre 120 paesi.
evidence.quote: Our business covers more than 120 countries and regions, including relays, medium and low voltage electrical appliances, high and low voltage complete equipment, connectors, capacitors, precision parts and automation equipment. || HONGFA has established three R&D and production bases in China (Xiamen-Zhangzhou, East and West) and a factory in Indonesia, successfully creating the advantage of a complete industrial chain with a complete range of products. || Hongfa maintains a stable relationship with global famous OEMs and Tier1 suppliers.
